text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is White Day. As a return gift for 
Valentine's Day, I decided to treat Ines 
Fujin to dinner.
choice_data_list: I found a nice place for us!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You sound pretty confident. Hehe, I 
wonder what kind of place it is~. I can't 
wait!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is where I see what you've 
got! I'll be counting on you to escort me 
today♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way to the restaurant, pausing for 
a moment to check the directions—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so this is the shop for today! Gotcha, 
gotcha! Actually, I used to work the floor 
here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I know the recommended menu, of course, 
but I also know secret tricks to combine 
dishes and make them even tastier! Ask me 
anything♪
choice_data_list: Ah, not here, it's a different shop.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we arrived at our destination. 
Passing through the hotel's prestigious 
lobby, we headed toward the restaurant 
entrance beside it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, here...? Really here? O-Ooh... It's 
so stylish...
choice_data_list: Was it not to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, that's not what I meant. Umm... 
it's more like I'm not really used to 
places like this...
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, I'll make sure to be a proper 
escort!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Um... Comté and, radis au beurre...? 
pintxos, steamed white fish... vapeur 
with... e-espuma? ...sauce...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...W-What kind of dish is this... !?
choice_data_list: Shall we order something else instead?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna ask, then. I can eat 
anything, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text:
...Your order has been taken. What would 
you like to drink? How about pairing it 
with a mocktail?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: In that case, two half-sizes, please.

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text: Certainly. Please take your time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, wow... It feels kind of 
grown-up...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Picking a place like this was a bit 
unexpected, too...
choice_data_list: I wanted you to have a special time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! You really put a lot of thought into 
this for me, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, I'm just totally losing to you 
today! I surrender!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Waiter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Here is your Orange 
Ginger Mocktail.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cheers...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while savoring the delicious 
food, I spent a delightful time with Ines 
Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, the meat was so delicious~. The 
knife just sliced right through it 
effortlessly. The atmosphere of the 
restaurant was super lovely, too—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I did get a bit nervous, but... 
...it became the absolute best memory!"
choice_data_list: I'm so glad you liked it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was a shop I'd normally never go 
into, so it felt so fresh and exciting! 
And also—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Plus, I got to see you looking all 
cool and smart, too☆"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! How about next time, I show you around 
somewhere you don't know?
choice_data_list: Sounds good! I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me! I'll escort you 
flawlessly, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —Then our outing is a promise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fuujin extends her pinky. Through her 
beaming smile and the firmness of the 
pinky promise, I felt a deep bond with 
her—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I want to take my little sisters out to 
eat sometime. Once I get my next paycheck—
choice_data_list: Let's all go out for a meal next time.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, really? Yay! Then I'll leave picking 
the restaurant to you♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fuujin was delighted, making this 
White Day a massive success.
